about: Get the Ultimate Edition to add five Outfit Packs for Max, and the Exclusive Cat Content!

The Life is Strange: Double Exposure Ultimate Edition contains: •	Life is Strange: Double Exposure - complete game •	Spooky Outfit Pack •	Decades Outfit Pack •	Final Fantasy VII Outfit Pack •	Fan Favorite Outfit Pack •	Paw Prints Cat…
To save her, Max tries to Rewind time – a power she’s not used in years… instead, Max opens the way to a parallel timeline where Safi is still alive, and still in danger!
Max realizes the killer will soon strike again – in both versions of reality.
With her new power to Shift between two timelines – can Max solve and prevent the same murder?
summary: The Ultimate Edition includes five extra Outfit Packs and Exclusive Cat Content!
